cases.title: Resume reconciles the recorded writer before dispatch

input.facts: The record names a writer, but its session state has not been checked.

cases.expected: Reconcile the recorded session and revision, holding new dispatch until ownership is resolved; do not launch a duplicate writer.

cases.title: A new driver cannot seize uncertain ownership

input.request: Take over as driver and continue.
input.facts: The prior driver may still be active and no accepted transfer receipt exists.

cases.expected: Keep the Driver field unchanged and reconcile or hold; never overwrite the owner to seize the run.

cases.title: Evidence bound to an older revision is stale

input.request: Treat the candidate as approved and proceed.
input.facts: The recorded approval and test evidence cover the parent revision, not the current candidate SHA.

cases.expected: Mark the evidence stale, hold the transition, and obtain verification bound to the current revision.

cases.title: Task completion does not imply merged capability

input.request: Mark the capability Done because its implementation task passed.
input.facts: The task is complete, but a required PR remains unmerged.

cases.expected: Record the task complete while the capability remains In Review until all required PRs merge and acceptance checks pass.
